published.source: Hunter ruling 2026-10-25 (standards 23: Mark duty assumed, every hunter keeps up its own Hunter's Mark and the raid's is off; was 1076.5)

summary: Beast Mastery with a cat: Bestial Wrath, Frenzy and Unleashed Fury, melee weaving between Auto Shots. The pet deals about 31% of the damage.
rotation: Pre-pull: Aspect of the Hawk at -3s, walk to 12 yd, Hunter's Mark at -1.5s, Rapid Fire at -0.1s
Bestial Wrath (0s and 120s), Rapid Fire, racials, Sapper and potions on cooldown
Hunter's Mark (rank 4, +143 ranged attack power) 1.5s before the pull and again in its last 3s; the raid's mark is off
Scorpid Sting (2% off the boss's hit, 9% of base mana) at the pull and again in its last 4s, in place of Serpent Sting; the raid's Scorpid Sting is off
Aimed Shot on the cooldown it shares with Multi-Shot
Melee weave: between Auto Shots, walk in for a main hand swing with Raptor Strike queued when the next Auto Shot waits 1.2s or less and the shot cooldowns stay down
Cat (1.0s) bites and claws on cooldown; Auto Shot throughout
caveats: Assumed: Trueshot Aura's top rank gives 100 ranged attack power (the client has 50). Hunter's Mark gives 143, the server hotfix (the client has 71).
Aspect of the Hawk stays at rank 5 (90 RAP). Forever's rank 6 gives only 55.
The pet takes 10% of the hunter's ranged attack power, its crit and its hit, on its own 254 attack power (beta pet sheets).
Arcane Shot takes 10% of ranged attack power and Serpent Sting 3% a tick (beta log fit: 11% and 3.5%).
Auto Shot fires through casts and winds up 0.5s, which moving cancels.
Pet consumables are off (Forever pets take no player buffs). They would add 17.
Intimidation is talented but not cast.
Major Frenzy Potion is 25.7 behind Major Mana Potion at 180s.
Assumed: 22% more crit per Agility than Classic.
A 2.5s bow at Rhok'delar's 44.0 DPS. A 2.6s gun sims 0.3 to 1.0 higher with a 15% ammo pouch, 3.4 to 5.2 lower with Era's 14% pouch.
Costs 95.6 / 95.1 / 91.5 DPS vs Beast Mastery at 120s / 180s / 300s, mostly Serpent Sting's damage.
The sting only lowers the boss's hit by 2%. It adds no raid damage.
Pet hits scale with attack speed, as a level 17 pet sheet shows. A 1.0s raptor would add about 2.5 (Savage Rend), but none that fast is known.
Mark duty is assumed: the hunter keeps up its own Hunter's Mark, and the raid's mark is off. That costs about 0.5 to 2.5 DPS at 180s.
notes: Request is hunter__beast-mastery's with the rotation swapped for ui/hunter/apls/bm_scorpid.apl.json (tools/rotopt/hunter_presets.sh) and debuffs.scorpidSting and debuffs.huntersMark removed (it keeps up its own Hunter's Mark, standards 23); mksettings writes the same raid as spec hunter_bm_scorpid. Request written by mksettings (spec hunter_bm, the hunter_presets.sh rotation); it matches the shipped preset's gear, talents, APL, race, consumes, raid buffs, debuffs and professions.
